about: Model hashes of candidate F as scripts/make_submission.py trains it on the team's Windows PC. scripts/real_run.py compares the trained model's manifest.json with these: a different gbdt hash stops the run (the training data changed); a different tcn or bundle.pkl hash alone is a warning (torch's CPU kernels changed). Update these only together with a change to the model (W6), never to make a run pass.
machine: the team's Windows PC (x86-64), with the locked environment of uv.lock
